leadText:
A Master Dojo Student (Japanese: マスターどうじょうのもんかせい Master Dojo Disciple) is a type of introduced in Generation VIII. They train in and assist with the Master Dojo's trials across the Isle of Armor. Master Dojo Students are battled in the Towers of Two Fists during 's training and in Restricted Sparring.

Students in the Towers train Pokémon of their respective type; types in the Tower of Darkness and types in the Tower of Waters. Master Dojo Students are the only opponents fought in Restricted Sparring, and unlike the player, can use a variety of types.
